stem: About 95 per cent of India's trade by volume but only 68 per cent by value moves by sea. What can best be inferred from these figures?
options: Sea routes carry 68 per cent of India's trade volume
Goods moved by sea earn more per tonne than goods sent by air
Sea cargo is mostly bulky goods of lower value per tonne
Land and air routes carry most of India's trade volume
explanation: Correct option: (C). If sea carries 95 per cent of the volume but only 68 per cent of the value, then the remaining 5 per cent of volume carried by other routes accounts for 32 per cent of value; so sea cargo is heavy and bulky with lower value per tonne, matching the idea that waterways suit heavy and bulky goods. (A) confuses value with volume, (B) reverses the inference, and (D) contradicts the 95 per cent volume figure.
